note: This taxonomy distinguishes disciplines from what can lawfully be practiced with open sources. Context-only entries are conceptual references, not operational collection guidance.

disciplines.name: Open Source Intelligence
disciplines.description: Intelligence derived from publicly available information.

disciplines.name: Social Media Intelligence
disciplines.description: Analysis of public social-media information and behavior.

disciplines.name: Geospatial Intelligence
disciplines.description: Geospatial analysis using maps, imagery and location data, including open sources.

disciplines.name: Imagery Intelligence
disciplines.description: Analysis of imagery, including publicly available imagery.

disciplines.name: Cyber Intelligence
disciplines.description: Intelligence about cyber infrastructure, threats and behaviors using authorized/public data.

disciplines.name: Cyber Threat Intelligence
disciplines.description: Defensive intelligence about threat actors, infrastructure, malware and behaviors.

disciplines.name: Financial Intelligence
disciplines.description: Analysis of lawful public financial, corporate and transaction records.

disciplines.name: Technical Intelligence
disciplines.description: Technical analysis of systems, products or artifacts using lawful public evidence.

disciplines.name: Document and Media Exploitation
disciplines.description: Extraction and analysis of information from lawfully obtained documents and media.

disciplines.name: Human Intelligence
disciplines.description: Intelligence derived from human sources; included for taxonomy context only.

disciplines.name: Signals Intelligence
disciplines.description: Intelligence from signals; included for taxonomy context only.

disciplines.name: Measurement and Signature Intelligence
disciplines.description: Technical measurement/signature intelligence; included for taxonomy context only.

disciplines.name: Medical Intelligence
disciplines.description: Medical intelligence discipline; included for taxonomy context only.
